title: Djoser depicted in the Saqqara Step Pyramid labyrinths, while later pyramids have no interior decoration

tellings.quote: the sakara step pyramid down in those labyrinths below that there are depictions of the pharaoh joer up on the wall in his iconic like striding forward in a he said festival.

plain: In the tunnels under the Step Pyramid at Saqqara in Egypt, the walls show the pharaoh Djoser "striding forward" in his well-known pose at a royal festival, while later pyramids are said to have no decoration inside at all. The researcher Luke Caverns tells Michels this without naming a source. He uses the contrast to ask whether the pyramids are what we usually think they are.
